title: Inference after latent variable estimation for single-cell RNA sequencing data (count splitting)
one_line_what_it_does: Poisson count splitting (binomial thinning) so clusters/latent variables are estimated on one count matrix and tested on the other; App. C tests difference in means of two estimated clusters; Prop. 2 shows train/test counts become correlated when the mean is itself random (NB/gamma), with correlation formula; epsilon tradeoff
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Core of the thinning step; Y1/Y2 construction; null-of-equal-means test after estimated clusters; why independence holds only conditional on the latent mean (claim 1 mechanism); epsilon (part 4, generic)

title: Data thinning for convolution-closed distributions
one_line_what_it_does: Splits one observation into independent parts for Poisson/NB/Gaussian/etc.; epsilon allocates Fisher information between selection and inference; thinning vs sample splitting
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Thinning construction; generic selection-vs-inference tradeoff in epsilon (part 4 generic form)

title: Generalized data thinning using sufficient statistics
authors: Dharamshi, Neufeld, Gao et al. (full list not retrieved)
one_line_what_it_does: General decomposition of X into independent parts via sufficient statistics; Section 7 applies thinning to changepoint detection (variance changepoints in wind speed): detect on one part, inference on the other
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Detect-then-test via thinning for 1-D changepoints; no spatial dependence, no continuity null, no RD statistic

title: Inference post region selection
one_line_what_it_does: Post-selection CIs for the mean signal in a data-selected rectangular region of a spatial domain via functional convergence of the selection-error process; motivates and contrasts with sample splitting and thinning
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Closest spatial post-selection paper (selected region, not boundary; no latent field; no RD)

title: Cross Validation for the log Gaussian Cox Process
one_line_what_it_does: Reviews p-thinning for LGCP: train/test point patterns are conditionally independent given the latent intensity lambda(s)
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Conditional independence of thinned counts given latent random intensity (classical; part of the model statement)

title: Approximate Marginal Posterior for Log Gaussian Cox Processes (p-thinning CV of Leininger & Gelfand 2016)
one_line_what_it_does: Uses p-thinning cross-validation for Cox processes, citing Leininger and Gelfand (2016); thinned patterns independent conditional on lambda
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Thinning under a spatially dependent latent intensity (priority for the 'independent given lambda' statement)

title: Decomposing Gaussians with Unknown Covariance
one_line_what_it_does: Gaussian data decomposition into independent parts when covariance unknown; motivates spatial/longitudinal dependent data; shows impossibility for n=1
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Thinning for dependent (spatially correlated) Gaussian data; not counts, no boundary

title: Testing for a change in mean after changepoint detection
one_line_what_it_does: Selective-inference test of no change in mean near an estimated changepoint (binary segmentation, l0, fused lasso); Gaussian, 1-D
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Post-detection inference baseline for part of the 'estimated boundary' problem; no spatial, no continuity null

title: Selective inference for hierarchical clustering
one_line_what_it_does: Finite-sample selective test of equal means between two estimated clusters; Gaussian, iid, known sigma
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Naive cluster-mean-difference null (claim 1 target) and its selective-inference fix

title: Selective inference for k-means clustering
one_line_what_it_does: Selective test for difference in means between k-means clusters, Gaussian model
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Same as above

title: Post-clustering difference testing: valid inference and practical considerations
one_line_what_it_does: Argues equal-means null can be rejected merely because clustering forces differences and proposes a continuum/unimodality-based test so clusters joined by a continuum are called not separated
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Conceptual twin of claim (1): null should be continuity/continuum, not equality of cluster means (non-spatial, iid, Gaussian-type)

title: False Discovery Rate Control via Data Splitting for Testing-after-Clustering
one_line_what_it_does: Data-splitting FDR control for DE after clustering; states spatial transcriptomics (correlated samples) is an open extension
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Confirms spatial dependence is flagged as open for splitting-after-clustering

title: Computing valid p-values for image segmentation by selective inference
one_line_what_it_does: Selective p-value for object-vs-background mean difference after segmentation; Gaussian pixels
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Region-difference test after estimated segmentation (claim 1 style null), via conditioning not thinning

title: Synthetic control removes spurious discoveries from double dipping in single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data analyses (ClusterDE)
one_line_what_it_does: Synthetic-null calibration of post-clustering DE for single-cell and spatial domains
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Spatial-transcriptomics double dipping handled without thinning or continuity theory

title: Regression discontinuity designs with unknown discontinuity points: testing and estimation
one_line_what_it_does: RD with an unknown jump location: sup-type tests and estimation of the jump point on the same data
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Estimated discontinuity location in RD (same-sample, no splitting, no random field)

title: Bayesian regression discontinuity design with unknown cutoff (LoTTA)
one_line_what_it_does: Bayesian RD propagating uncertainty in cutoff location
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Unknown-cutoff RD; no thinning

title: Boundary Discontinuity Designs: Theory and Practice
one_line_what_it_does: Review of 2-D boundary discontinuity designs with a KNOWN boundary curve; location-based local polynomial inference along the boundary
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: RD statistic along a boundary and RBC machinery (part 2-3 ingredients), known boundary only

title: Robust inference for geographic regression discontinuity designs: assessing the impact of police precincts
one_line_what_it_does: GeoRDD for spatial point processes with intensity jump across a known border; placebo-border calibration
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Point-process intensity discontinuity test across a fixed boundary

title: Bayesian wombling: curvilinear gradient assessment under spatial process models
one_line_what_it_does: Tests whether a curve is a wombling boundary via posterior of line integral of gradient of a GP; algorithmic wombling picks top-gradient points then tests them on the same data
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Geostatistical significance of selected boundaries under a continuous random field (model-based, same data)

title: Bayesian spatiotemporal wombling
one_line_what_it_does: Wombling boundary inference in hierarchical spatiotemporal models
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Same family

title: Optimal inference after model selection
one_line_what_it_does: Selection-inference tradeoff of data splitting vs data carving
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: General selection-inference tradeoff for epsilon

title: Inference conditional on selection: a review
one_line_what_it_does: Reviews data thinning/splitting/CSI; epsilon as Fisher-information allocation
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Survey of thinning and its epsilon tradeoff

title: Post-selection inference with a single realization of a network
one_line_what_it_does: Thins Poisson/Gaussian edges to estimate a structure on one network and do selective-coverage inference on the other
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Same detect-on-thin-1, test-on-thin-2 pattern for estimated network structure

title: TUNE: Algorithm-agnostic inference after changepoint detection
one_line_what_it_does: Universal-threshold FWER control for detected changepoints, any detector
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Post-detection inference without splitting
